description:
Berlin apartment building market (rental buildings, "Zinshäuser") - transaction data. Source: transaction data from the Berlin committee of valuation experts (GAA, Gutachterausschuss).

Parameters:
- rbs: "stadt" | "bezirk" | "stadtteil" | "ortsteil" — bezirk = Borough, ortsteil = District

Time filters:
- start/end: flexible date values (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD)
- recent: number of most recent periods (alternative to start/end)

Additional filters:
- bezirk_id, stadtteil_id, ortsteil_id
- limit, fields, include: "metadata"

The current year is still incomplete: compare it to past years through anzahl_transaktionen_prognose and transaktionsvolumen_prognose (projected full-year values, data date in prognose_basis), not through the partial counts. vielfaches_delta_1j/5j/10j/15j hold the absolute change of the multiplier.

Ideal for: investment market analysis, yield comparisons across locations

Key response fields (German names):
- transaktionspreis: Average transaction price per apartment building
- transaktionspreis_delta_proz_1j: Percentage change in average transaction price per apartment building compared to previous year
- anzahl_transaktionen: Total number of apartment building transactions in the reporting period
- anzahl_transaktionen_prognose: Projected number of transactions for the current year, from two complete quarters. Sum of the complete quarters divided by the middle value of their share of the year in the five previous years. In backtests from 2020 to 2025 it was off the annual figure by 10 % on average after two quarters and by 4 % after three. Current year only, from Berlin down to Ortsteil.
- transaktionsvolumen_prognose: Projected transaction volume for the current year in euros, from three complete quarters, because single large sales shift a quarter considerably. Sum of the complete quarters divided by the middle value of their share of the annual volume in the five previous years. In backtests from 2020 to 2025 it was off the annual figure by 10 % on average. Current year only, from Berlin down to Ortsteil.
- vielfaches: Average ratio of purchase price to annual rental income (also known as gross income factor)
- vielfaches_delta_proz_1j: Percentage change in purchase price factor compared to previous year
- transaktionspreis_m2: Average transaction price per square meter of living space
